What this app does, and what is planned

Now: read-only consented collection for your DANIM account; the copilot (spoken briefing and voice questions through Pleos speech, a hand-off to Pleos navigation, and three read-only functions for the Gleo assistant); fixed public records for the competition; and owner-consented AI access through DANIM. Unknown stays unknown.

Planned, not in this app: vehicle control, location, push, keys and billing. This build ships no command, location, push, key or billing code; the automations in the copilot are concepts that send nothing.
Each opens only when the Pleos SDK is available to DANIM and the OEM grants the entitlement, behind its own design, consent copy and safety review.

Trips, charging, battery trends, reports and AI connections for this car are on the DANIM web. The code carries only the site address.
Spoken briefings, voice questions, driving prompts, charging advice and automation concepts through the Pleos speech and navigation SDKs. Plan and tariff are examples; no command is sent to the car.
